supersede_reason: Owner decision (see scene-05-generation-attempts-status.json): stop local deterministic compositing of generated air fryer/kitchen/basket plates for scene-05 -- C1 (duplicate AI product + placement mismatch), C2 (hand/product occlusion mismatch) and C3 (correct geometry, but the pasted real-product-v1 layer still shows visible seams/artifacts) all showed this compositing mechanism keeps producing the same class of defect regardless of transform accuracy. New policy: PRODUCT ONLY MEANS PRODUCT ONLY -- real-product-v1 is the one and only permanent visual reference in this project (campaign_visual_policy.json: mandatory_product_reference, forbidden_global_reference_categories). Everything else (kitchen, air fryer, basket, food, hands, person, clothing, lighting, generated plates, previous candidate composites) is generated per scene from text only, never image-locked, never carried forward as a reusable visual asset.

model_prompt_draft: Cozy clean white home kitchen, warm daylight coming from the left. Black air fryer with an open square basket, high 3/4 top-down camera angle looking down into the basket. Inside the basket, a square silicone baking form matching the reference image exactly: dark grey matte silicone, flat corner handle tabs on each side, a short horizontal slot in each tab, ribbed bottom. Do not redesign the handles. Do not draw loop handles. Do not draw vertical oval holes. Do not draw a duplicate tray or a second product. Inside the form, exactly 3 roasted golden chicken thighs with potato wedges. The basket is clean around the form. No hands, no arms, no fingers, no person anywhere in the frame. Realistic home cooking photo, DSLR 50mm look, shallow depth of field. No CGI, no illustration, no 3D render. No text, no watermark, no logo. Vertical 9:16, 720x1280.
